claim: On the BIRD test set the top systems are AskData+GPT-4o at 81.95% EX, Agentar-Scale-SQL at 81.67%, Xiaomi Text2SQL at 80.83%, CHASE-SQL+Gemini at 76.02%, and XiYan-SQL at 75.63%, versus human performance of 92.96%.
quote: Human Performance: 92.96%; AskData + GPT-4o 81.95% EX; Agentar-Scale-SQL 81.67%; Xiaomi 80.83%; CHASE-SQL + Gemini 76.02%; XiYan-SQL 75.63%

claim: XiYan-SQL reaches 75.63% EX on BIRD test and 89.65% on Spider test; its ablation shows schema linking adds about 2.15 points (57.95% to 60.10%) and the M-Schema representation beats DDL schema by an average 2.03% across four LLMs.
quote: M-Schema demonstrated superior performance compared to DDL Schema, with an average increase of 2.03%; schema linking improved execution accuracy by 2.15 percentage points (57.95% to 60.10%)

claim: CHASE-SQL achieves 73.01% dev / 73.0% test EX on BIRD; ablations show divide-and-conquer CoT contributes -1.24% when removed, query-plan CoT -0.65%, synthetic examples -0.85%, the fine-tuned selection agent beats self-consistency by ~4-5 points, and the oracle upper bound with perfect candidate selection is 82.79%.
quote: With perfect selection from all three generators combined: 82.79% execution accuracy; Without Divide-and-Conquer CoT: -1.24%; Without Query Plan CoT: -0.65%; Without Online Synthetic Examples: -0.85%

claim: Spider 2.0 targets enterprise workflows with databases over 1,000 (some >3,000) columns, multiple dialects (BigQuery, Snowflake, DuckDB), and queries often exceeding 100 lines; GPT-4o baseline solves only 10.1% and o1-preview 17.1%, while current Spider2-Lite leaders reach ~73% (DivSkill-SQL 73.13%) and Spider2-Snow agent leaders exceed 96%.
quote: GPT-4o baseline: 10.1% success rate on Spider 2.0; o1-preview baseline: 17.1%; Databases with over 1,000 columns (some exceeding 3,000); DivSkill-SQL: 73.13%

claim: The 'Death of Schema Linking?' paper finds that with strong reasoning models full-schema prompting reaches 94.62% EX and explicit schema-linking filters cause net losses (e.g. table-to-column linking drops to as low as 9.79%); top models like Gemini 1.5 Pro see a net EX reduction when schema linking is applied, while weaker models still benefit from filtering.
quote: Top performing models, such as Gemini 1.5 Pro, see a net reduction in EX when schema linking is applied, while weaker models still benefit from filtering approaches; Full Schema: 94.62% execution accuracy

claim: A context-aware bidirectional schema-linking ablation across GPT-4o-mini, Gemini, DeepSeek and Qwen reports Schema Linking Recall and False Positive Rate as the critical levers, with bidirectional linking giving best trade-off (recall 92.91% Gemini, 91.56% DeepSeek; FPR 25.75% and 19.04%).
quote: Full bidirectional schema linking approaches consistently deliver the best trade-off across models, achieving the highest recall (92.91% for Gemini and 91.56% for DeepSeek), while maintaining relatively low FPRs (25.75% and 19.04%, respectively)

claim: Snowflake's Arctic-Text2SQL-R1, a smaller RL-trained model, tops BIRD and wins broadly, showing reinforcement-learning post-training competing with large ensemble pipelines on schema-grounded SQL generation.
quote: Smaller Models, Smarter SQL: Arctic-Text2SQL-R1 Tops BIRD and Wins Broadly
